title: UneceFieldCrop
description: A field with one or more cultivated plants or produce from one or more botanical species or varieties.

applicableAgriculturalProcess.description: An agricultural process crop production applicable for this field crop.

appliedAgriculturalApplication.description: An agricultural application applied to this field crop.

className.description: The class name, expressed as a text, for this field crop.

classificationCode.description: A code specifying a classification for this field crop.

cultivationContainerCode.description: The code specifying the type of cultivation container, such as a pot or an iron cabinet, for this field crop.

cultivationCoverageCode.description: A code specifying a type of cultivation coverage, such as glass, for this field crop.

cultivationMediumCode.description: The code specifying the type of cultivation medium, such as substrate, for this field crop.

cultivationTypeCode.description: The code specifying the type of cultivation for this field crop.

description.description: The textual description for this field crop.

grownPlot.description: The plot where this field crop is grown.

grownPreviousCrop.description: A field crop grown previous to this field crop.

harvestDateTime.description: The date, time, date time, or other date time value for the harvest of this field crop.

harvestedProduce.description: Produce harvested from this field crop.

plantingReasonCode.description: A code specifying a reason for planting this field crop.

productionEnvironmentCode.description: The code specifying the production environment for this field crop.

productionPeriodCode.description: The code specifying the production period for this field crop.

propagationMaterialIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not a field crop is to be used as propagation material.

purposeCode.description: A code specifying a purpose for this field crop.

sowingPeriodCode.description: The code specifying the sowing period for this field crop, such as spring or winter.

specifiedAgriculturalCharacteristic.description: An agricultural characteristic specified for this field crop.

specifiedCropMixtureConstituent.description: A field crop mixture constituent specified for this field crop.
